The records provide tonnes poured against orders so far (which we treat as the backlog to be cleared) and daily throughput rates. The throughput for Zlato is corrected to 100 tonnes per day by the zlato-line record. Calculating the time for each:

- Perm: 220 tonnes / 60 tonnes per day ≈ 3.67 days
- Zlato: 300 tonnes / 100 tonnes per day = 3 days
- Ufa: 250 tonnes / 45 tonnes per day ≈ 5.56 days

Ufa takes the longest time.

ANSWER: ufa
